Sitemaps scanned for all checklist names: no match besides Anfix. FR/ES/IT business landing pages not located (guessed URLs 404), checked via sitemap only.

editors.notes: Main source is the help-centre article, which lists software per country (NL, DE, FR, IE, ES); identical list in all language versions; no BE, IT or UK list. Names kept as written (e.g. 'Exact', 'Sage', 'Microsoft Dynamics', 'Afas Software' without product precision). List mixes accounting tools with invoicing, cash-management and other fintech apps; all kept since bunq labels them bookkeeping software. Mechanism stated generically as bunq API + OAuth; DATEV and BuchhaltungsButler pages describe a finAPI bank connection. Marketing index shows only 12 logos (JS pagination); sitemap exposes 35 per-software pages, 9 sampled. Not found: Xero, QuickBooks, lexoffice/Lexware Office, Holded, Odoo, Visma, Octopus, WinBooks.

editors.notes: Germany: DATEV (EBICS / RZ-Bankinfo) and Lexware Office are co-developed interfaces; the others connect through the standard PSD2 interface. DATEV-format report export (SKR 03/04) also exists. Finland: bank connections (SFTP channel per English page) plus CSV/XML reports. Not included as non-accounting tools: BillBee, MoneyMoney, Agicap, Commitly, Tidely, GetMyInvoices (DE); Lemon tree (accounting firm), Finago eTasku, Finago Isolta, Ukko, Dropbox (FI). 'Oodo' is the site's spelling of Odoo. Countries taken from the country edition of the site (Holvi Deutschland / Finnish site). Austrian edition and support.holvi.com not read in detail.

'lexware' and 'lexoffice' both appear on the same page; product behind 'lexware' is ambiguous (probably Lexware Office). FastBill page exists only in the English sitemap and may be legacy. Debitoor pages are gone. DATEV-format export with receipts and CSV export are also offered. Site is Germany-only but pages do not state the country.
